cards.front: Recall a key point about The Big Bang & Expansion
cards.back: The Big Bang theory states the universe began from an extremely hot, dense singularity ~13.8 billion years ago

cards.front: Recall a key point about The Big Bang & Expansion
cards.back: Hubble's law: v = H₀d — recession velocity is proportional to distance; further galaxies recede faster

cards.front: Recall a key point about The Big Bang & Expansion
cards.back: Cosmological redshift occurs because space itself is expanding, stretching light to longer wavelengths

cards.front: Recall a key point about The Big Bang & Expansion
cards.back: The cosmic microwave background (CMB) is the afterglow of the Big Bang, at ~2.7 K

cards.front: Recall a key point about The Big Bang & Expansion
cards.back: The CMB is remarkably uniform, with tiny fluctuations that correspond to the seeds of large-scale structure

cards.front: Recall a key point about The Big Bang & Expansion
cards.back: Olbers' paradox (why the sky is dark at night) is resolved by the finite age and expansion of the universe

cards.front: What should you know about gcse astronomy exam tips — the big bang & expansion?
cards.back: 1. For The Big Bang & Expansion questions, define key terms before explaining processes 2. Use 'because' to link cause and effect in your explanations 3. For extended response questions, plan your answer: identify AO1/AO2/AO3 requirements first
